headline: Frasers Centrepoint Trust Achieves Record Distribution per Unit in Singapore
summary: Frasers Centrepoint Trust posted a 2.6% increase in second-half distribution per unit, lifting full-year payout to a record $0.1235 for unitholders.
why: Frasers Centrepoint Trust is a major Singapore retail REIT, whose distribution performance reflects retail tenant demand and suburban consumer traffic.

impacts.name: Frasers Centrepoint Trust
impacts.why: Record DPU distributions reward income investors and underscore steady suburban mall rental yields.
